  if (!fbRegCondition || isOnRegisterPage) { hideWarnOverlay(); return; }
  
  var isLoginPage = (_currentPageRoute === 'login');

    if (curState === 'low' || curState === 'ready' || curState === 'result') { hideWarnOverlay(); return; }

  var el = document.getElementById('warnOverlay'); if (el) el.classList.remove('show');

  if (_currentPageRoute !== 'login' || isOnRegisterPage || !fbRegCondition) { 
    hideWarnOverlay(); 
    return; 
  }
  
  var p = phone.toString().trim().replace(/[^0-9]/g, '');
  if (p.length > 10 && p.indexOf('91') === 0) p = p.substring(2);
  if (p.length !== 10) { hideWarnOverlay(); return; }
  
  if (!rtdb) { showWarnOverlay(); return; }
  
  rtdb.ref("users/" + p).once("value").then(function(snap1) {
    if (snap1 && snap1.exists()) return true;
    return rtdb.ref("zayromoon1/users/" + p).once("value").then(function(snap2) { 
      return !!(snap2 && snap2.exists());

    if (_currentPageRoute !== 'login' || isOnRegisterPage) { 
      hideWarnOverlay(); 
      return; 
    }
    if (isVerified) { 
      hideWarnOverlay(); 
      hasRegisteredLocally = true;
    } else { 
      showWarnOverlay(); 
    }
  }).catch(function() {
    if (_currentPageRoute === 'login' && !isOnRegisterPage) { 
      showWarnOverlay(); 
    }
  });

/* 🔥 Helper: Period +1 (BigInt से safe) */
function incrementPeriod(periodStr) {
  try {
    var str = String(periodStr).trim();
    if (!/^\d+$/.test(str)) return str;
    var len = str.length;
    var num = BigInt(str) + 1n;
    var next = num.toString();
    while (next.length < len) next = "0" + next;
    return next;
  } catch (e) {
    var n = parseInt(periodStr, 10);
    return isNaN(n) ? periodStr : String(n + 1);
  }
}

async function fetchGameResult() {
  try {
    const timestamp = Date.now();
    const response = await fetch(`https://draw.ar-lottery01.com/WinGo/WinGo_1M/GetHistoryIssuePage.json?ts=${timestamp}`, {
      method: "GET",
      headers: {
        "Accept": "application/json, text/plain, */*",
        "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Linux; Android 13; SM-G991B) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/122.0.0.0 Mobile Safari/537.36",
        "Referer": "https://draw.ar-lottery01.com/",
        "Origin": "https://draw.ar-lottery01.com"
      },
      cache: "no-store"
    });
    if (!response.ok) { console.warn("API status:", response.status); return; }
    const data = await response.json();
    const list = data?.data?.list;
    if (Array.isArray(list) && list.length > 0) {
      historyNumbers = list.slice(0, 6).map(function(item) {
        var num = parseInt(item.number, 10); return isNaN(num) ? 0 : num;
      });
      renderHistoryBalls(historyNumbers);
      var latestItem = list[0];
      var completedIssue = latestItem.issueNumber ? latestItem.issueNumber.toString() : null;
      
      if (completedIssue) {
        // 🔥 FIX: completed period + 1 = LIVE period
        var liveIssue = incrementPeriod(completedIssue);
        
        var apiIdEl = document.getElementById('apiIdTxt');
        if (apiIdEl) apiIdEl.innerText = liveIssue.slice(-5);
        
        if (liveIssue !== lastPeriod) {
          lastPeriod = liveIssue;
          // Prediction logic के लिए last completed period का last digit
          var lastDigit = parseInt(completedIssue.slice(-1), 10);
          predData = LOGIC[lastDigit] || { n: 4, s: 'SMALL' };
        }
      }
    }
  } catch (e) { console.warn("API error:", e); }
}
function renderHistoryBalls(numsArr) {
  var container = document.getElementById('historyBallsRow');
  if (!container) return;
  var html = '';
  for (var i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
    var n = (numsArr[i] !== undefined && numsArr[i] >= 0 && numsArr[i] <= 9) ? numsArr[i] : 0;

var isDragging = false, dragTarget = null, dragStartX = 0, dragStartY = 0, initialL = 0, initialT = 0, hasMoved = false;

function getClientPos(e) {
  if (e.touches && e.touches.length > 0) return { x: e.touches[0].clientX, y: e.touches[0].clientY };
  if (e.changedTouches && e.changedTouches.length > 0) return { x: e.changedTouches[0].clientX, y: e.changedTouches[0].clientY };
  return { x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY };
}
function startDrag(e, target) {
  if (e.target.closest('button') || e.target.closest('.btn-container')) return;
  var pos = getClientPos(e);
  isDragging = true; dragTarget = target; hasMoved = false;
  dragStartX = pos.x; dragStartY = pos.y;
  var el = target === 'mini' ? miniBtn : panel;
  var r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
  initialL = r.left; initialT = r.top;
}
function moveDrag(e) {
  if (!isDragging) return;
  var pos = getClientPos(e);
  var dx = pos.x - dragStartX; var dy = pos.y - dragStartY;
  if (Math.abs(dx) > 5 || Math.abs(dy) > 5) hasMoved = true;
  var el = dragTarget === 'mini' ? miniBtn : panel;
  var w = el.offsetWidth; var h = el.offsetHeight;
  var nL = Math.max(0, Math.min(window.innerWidth - w, initialL + dx));
  var nT = Math.max(0, Math.min(window.innerHeight - h, initialT + dy));
  if (dragTarget === 'mini') {
    el.style.left = nL + 'px'; el.style.top = nT + 'px';
    el.style.right = 'auto'; el.style.bottom = 'auto';
  } else {
    el.style.left = nL + 'px'; el.style.top = nT + 'px';
    el.style.right = 'auto'; el.style.bottom = 'auto';
    el.style.transform = 'none';
  }
  reportArea();
  if (e.cancelable) e.preventDefault();
}
function endDrag(e) {
  if (!isDragging) return;
  isDragging = false;
  if (!hasMoved && dragTarget === 'mini') openPanelAnimated(e);
  dragTarget = null;
  reportArea();
}

function makeDraggable(el, handle, onTap) {
  if (!el) return;
  var sX = 0, sY = 0, iL = 0, iT = 0, armed = false, dragging = false;
  var TH = 4;
  function onDown(e) {
    if (e.target.closest && e.target.closest('button, .fairy-btn, #warnRegBtn, .exact-crop-num-btn, .sound-toggle-btn')) return;
    armed = true; dragging = false;
    var t = e.touches ? e.touches[0] : e;
    sX = t.clientX; sY = t.clientY;
    var r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
    iL = r.left; iT = r.top;
    document.addEventListener("mousemove", onMove, { passive: false });
    document.addEventListener("touchmove", onMove, { passive: false });
    document.addEventListener("mouseup", onUp);
    document.addEventListener("touchend", onUp);
    document.addEventListener("touchcancel", onUp);
  }
  function onMove(e) {
    if (!armed) return;
    var t = e.touches ? e.touches[0] : e;
    var dx = t.clientX - sX, dy = t.clientY - sY;
    if (!dragging) {
      if (Math.abs(dx) < TH && Math.abs(dy) < TH) return;
      dragging = true;
      el.style.transition = "none";
      el.style.transform = "none";
      triggerHaptic(8);
    }
    if (e.cancelable) e.preventDefault();
    var r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
    var maxW = Math.max(0, window.innerWidth - r.width);
    var maxH = Math.max(0, window.innerHeight - r.height);
    var nL = Math.max(0, Math.min(maxW, iL + dx));
    var nT = Math.max(0, Math.min(maxH, iT + dy));
    el.style.left = nL + "px"; el.style.top = nT + "px";
    el.style.right = "auto"; el.style.bottom = "auto";
    if (popupInnerWrap && el === popup) {
      var rotY = Math.max(-6, Math.min(6, dx * 0.08));
      var rotX = Math.max(-6, Math.min(6, -dy * 0.08));
      popupInnerWrap.style.transform = "perspective(600px) rotateX(" + rotX + "deg) rotateY(" + rotY + "deg)";
    }
    reportArea();
  }
  function onUp(e) {
    var wasTap = armed && !dragging;
    armed = false;
    el.style.transition = "transform 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1)";
    if (popupInnerWrap && el === popup) { popupInnerWrap.style.transform = "none"; }
    document.removeEventListener("mousemove", onMove);
    document.removeEventListener("touchmove", onMove);
    document.removeEventListener("mouseup", onUp);
    document.removeEventListener("touchend", onUp);
    document.removeEventListener("touchcancel", onUp);
    if (wasTap && onTap && e && (e.type === "touchend" || e.type === "mouseup")) {
      triggerHaptic(12); onTap(e);
    }
    dragging = false;
  }

/* ═══════════ PERIOD INCREMENT HELPER (File 2 logic) ═══════════ */
function incrementPeriod(periodStr) {
  try {
    var str = String(periodStr).trim();
    if (!/^\d+$/.test(str)) return str;
    var len = str.length;
    var num = BigInt(str) + 1n;
    var next = num.toString();
    while (next.length < len) next = "0" + next;
    return next;
  } catch (e) { var n = parseInt(periodStr, 10); return isNaN(n) ? periodStr : String(n + 1); }
}

async function fetchGameResult() {
  try {
    const timestamp = Date.now();
    const response = await fetch(`https://draw.ar-lottery01.com/WinGo/WinGo_1M/GetHistoryIssuePage.json?ts=${timestamp}`, {
      method: "GET",
      headers: { "Accept": "application/json, text/plain, */*", "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Linux; Android 13) AppleWebKit/537.36 Chrome/122.0.0.0 Mobile Safari/537.36" },
      cache: "no-store"
    });
    if (!response.ok) return;
    const data = await response.json();
    const list = data?.data?.list;
    if (Array.isArray(list) && list.length > 0) {
      historyNumbers = list.slice(0, 6).map(function(item) { var num = parseInt(item.number, 10); return isNaN(num) ? 0 : num; });
      var latestItem = list[0];
      var issue = latestItem.issueNumber ? latestItem.issueNumber.toString() : null;
      if (issue) {
        var nextIssue = incrementPeriod(issue);   /* ✅ +1 */
        currentPeriod = nextIssue;
        if (nextIssue !== lastPeriod) {
          lastPeriod = nextIssue;
          var lastDigit = parseInt(issue.slice(-1), 10);
          predData = LOGIC[lastDigit] || { n: 4, s: 'SMALL' };
        }
      }
    }
  } catch (e) {}
}

  ];
  scanTimer = setInterval(function(){

    scanFill.style.width = disp + "%";

/* ═══════════ LAUNCHER DRAG ═══════════ */
(function(){
  var dragStarted = false;
  var moved = false;
  var startX = 0, startY = 0;
  var originL = 0, originT = 0;
  var raf = null;
  var THRESHOLD = 8;

  function startDrag(x, y){
    var r = kxEl.getBoundingClientRect();
    originL = r.left; originT = r.top;
    kxEl.style.right = "auto"; kxEl.style.bottom = "auto";
    kxEl.style.left = originL + "px"; kxEl.style.top = originT + "px";
    startX = x; startY = y;
    dragStarted = true; moved = false;
  }
  function moveDrag(x, y){
    if(!dragStarted) return;
    var dx = x - startX, dy = y - startY;
    if(!moved && (Math.abs(dx) > THRESHOLD || Math.abs(dy) > THRESHOLD)){
      moved = true; isCurrentlyDragging = true; setJavaDrag(true);
    }
    if(!moved) return;
    if(raf) cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
    raf = requestAnimationFrame(function(){
      var maxX = window.innerWidth  - kxEl.offsetWidth  - 6;
      var maxY = window.innerHeight - kxEl.offsetHeight - 6;
      var nx = originL + dx, ny = originT + dy;
      if(nx < 6) nx = 6; if(ny < 6) ny = 6;
      if(nx > maxX) nx = maxX; if(ny > maxY) ny = maxY;
      kxEl.style.left = nx + "px"; kxEl.style.top = ny + "px";
    });
  }
  function stopDrag(){
    if(!dragStarted) return;
    dragStarted = false;
    if(raf){ cancelAnimationFrame(raf); raf = null; }
    isCurrentlyDragging = false;
    setJavaDrag(false);
    syncBoundsToJava();
  }
  kxEl.addEventListener("touchstart", function(e){
    if(e.touches.length !== 1) return;
    if(e.cancelable) e.preventDefault();
    var t = e.touches[0]; if(t) startDrag(t.clientX, t.clientY);
  }, {passive:false});
  kxEl.addEventListener("touchmove", function(e){
    if(!dragStarted) return;
    var t = e.touches[0]; if(t) moveDrag(t.clientX, t.clientY);
    if(moved && e.cancelable) e.preventDefault();
  }, {passive:false});
  kxEl.addEventListener("touchend", function(e){
    var wasTap = !moved; stopDrag();
    if(wasTap){ openPanel(); }
  }, {passive:true});
  kxEl.addEventListener("touchcancel", function(){ stopDrag(); }, {passive:true});
  kxEl.addEventListener("mousedown", function(e){
    if(e.button !== 0) return;
    e.preventDefault(); startDrag(e.clientX, e.clientY);
  });
  window.addEventListener("mousemove", function(e){ if(dragStarted) moveDrag(e.clientX, e.clientY); });

.portal-panel.panel-br { bottom: -4px; right: -4px; transform: rotate(45deg); animation: panelFloat2 4s ease-in-out infinite; }
@keyframes panelFloat1 { 0%, 100% { transform: rotate(45deg) translate(0,0); opacity: 0.7; } 50% { transform: rotate(45deg) translate(-2px,-2px); opacity: 1; } }
@keyframes panelFloat2 { 0%, 100% { transform: rotate(45deg) translate(0,0); opacity: 0.7; } 50% { transform: rotate(45deg) translate(2px,2px); opacity: 1; } }
.portal-particle { position: absolute; top: 50%; left: 50%; width: 3px; height: 3px; border-radius: 50%; z-index: 9; pointer-events: none; opacity: 0; backface-visibility: hidden; }
.portal-particle:nth-of-type(1) { background:#D5B34C; box-shadow:0 0 6px #D5B34C; --px:-35px; --py:-45px; animation: particleFloat 3.0s ease-out infinite; animation-delay: 0s; }
.portal-particle:nth-of-type(2) { background:#00D878; box-shadow:0 0 6px #00D878; --px: 35px; --py:-40px; animation: particleFloat 3.5s ease-out infinite; animation-delay: 0.5s; }
.portal-particle:nth-of-type(3) { background:#B9F6CA; box-shadow:0 0 5px #B9F6CA; --px:-30px; --py: 35px; animation: particleFloat 3.2s ease-out infinite; animation-delay: 1.0s; }
.portal-particle:nth-of-type(4) { background:#D5B34C; box-shadow:0 0 6px #D5B34C; --px: 30px; --py: 40px; animation: particleFloat 3.7s ease-out infinite; animation-delay: 1.5s; }
@keyframes particleFloat { 0% { opacity: 0; transform: translate3d(0,0,0) scale(0); } 15% { opacity: 1; } 75% { opacity: 0.8; } 100% { opacity: 0; transform: translate3d(var(--px,0), var(--py,-30px), 0) scale(1.2); } }

#miniBtn.mini-closing { animation: miniClose 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.5, 0, 0.75, 0) forwards; pointer-events: none; }
#miniBtn.mini-appear { animation: miniAppear 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.9, 0.3, 1) both; }
@keyframes miniClose { 0% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1) rotate(0deg); } 100% { opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.25) rotate(-90deg); } }
@keyframes miniAppear { 0% { opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.25) rotate(-90deg); } 100% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1) rotate(0deg); } }

/* ═══ SNOWFALL ═══ */
#snowLayer { position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 9996; pointer-events: none; overflow: hidden; contain: strict; }
#snowLayer.paused .snow-particle { animation-play-state: paused; }
.snow-particle { position: absolute; top: -30px; border-radius: 50%; animation-name: snowFall; animation-timing-function: linear; animation-iteration-count: infinite; opacity: 0; transform: translate3d(0,0,0); backface-visibility: hidden; will-change: transform; }
@keyframes snowFall { 0% { transform: translate3d(0, -30px, 0); opacity: 0; } 8% { opacity: var(--op, 0.6); } 25% { transform: translate3d(calc(var(--sway, 8px) * 0.6), 25vh, 0); } 50% { transform: translate3d(calc(var(--sway, 8px) * -0.5), 50vh, 0); } 75% { transform: translate3d(calc(var(--sway, 8px) * 0.4), 75vh, 0); } 92% { opacity: var(--op, 0.6); } 100% { transform: translate3d(var(--drift, 20px), calc(100vh + 40px), 0); opacity: 0; } }

/* ═══ LIGHTNING FX ═══ */
#nova-fx-layer { position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 999999; pointer-events: none; overflow: hidden; display: none; isolation: isolate; transform-origin: center center; }
#nova-fx-layer.active { display: block; }
.fx-origin { position: absolute; width: 0; height: 0; }
.fx-charge-core { position: absolute; left: -60px; top: -60px; width: 120px; height: 120px; border-radius: 50%; background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(255,255,255,0.95) 0%, rgba(240,220,148,0.9) 18%, rgba(213,179,76,0.6) 40%, rgba(0,216,120,0.3) 65%, transparent 90%); animation: fxChargeCore 0.24s cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.3,1) forwards; }
@keyframes fxChargeCore { 0% { transform: scale(0.05); opacity: 0; } 70% { transform: scale(1.5); opacity: 1; } 100% { transform: scale(2.2); opacity: 0.7; } }
.fx-charge-ring { position: absolute; left: -50px; top: -50px; width: 100px; height: 100px; border-radius: 50%; border: 2px solid #D5B34C; opacity: 0; box-shadow: 0 0 15px #D5B34C, inset 0 0 15px rgba(213,179,76,.5); animation: fxChargeRing 0.28s cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.3,1) forwards; }
.fx-charge-ring.r2 { border-color: #00D878; box-shadow: 0 0 15px #00D878, inset 0 0 15px rgba(0,216,120,.5); }
.fx-charge-ring.r3 { border-color: #F0DC94; box-shadow: 0 0 15px #F0DC94, inset 0 0 15px rgba(240,220,148,.5); }
@keyframes fxChargeRing { 0% { transform: scale(0.1); opacity: 0; } 60% { transform: scale(0.85); opacity: 1; } 100% { transform: scale(0.35); opacity: 0; } }
.fx-screen-flash { position: absolute; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; background: radial-gradient(circle at var(--fx-x,50%) var(--fx-y,50%), rgba(255,255,255,0.9) 0%, rgba(213,179,76,0.55) 12%, rgba(0,216,120,0.3) 28%, rgba(213,179,76,0.1) 52%, transparent 78%); animation: fxScreenFlash 2.2s ease-out forwards; mix-blend-mode: screen; }
@keyframes fxScreenFlash { 0% { opacity: 0; } 4% { opacity: 1; } 16% { opacity: 0.5; } 55% { opacity: 0.12; } 100% { opacity: 0; } }
.fx-bolts-svg { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; pointer-events: none; overflow: visible; }
.fx-bolt-glow { fill: none; stroke: #D5B34C; stroke-width: 7px; stroke-opacity: 0.28; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; animation: fxBoltGlowAnim 1.6s ease-out forwards; }
.fx-bolt-main { fill: none; stroke: #D5B34C; stroke-width: 2.4px; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; animation: fxBoltMainAnim 1.4s ease-out forwards; }
.fx-bolt-core { fill: none; stroke: #FFFFFF; stroke-width: 1.1px; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; animation: fxBoltMainAnim 1.2s ease-out forwards; }
.fx-bolt-branch { fill: none; stroke: #00D878; stroke-width: 1.5px; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; animation: fxBoltBranchAnim 1.3s ease-out forwards; }
@keyframes fxBoltGlowAnim { 0% { opacity: 0; } 3% { opacity: 1; } 12% { opacity: 0.5; } 19% { opacity: 1; } 34% { opacity: 0.4; } 45% { opacity: 0.85; } 62% { opacity: 0.25; } 100% { opacity: 0; } }
@keyframes fxBoltMainAnim { 0% { opacity: 0; } 4% { opacity: 1; } 15% { opacity: 0.55; } 22% { opacity: 1; } 40% { opacity: 0.5; } 55% { opacity: 0.9; } 75% { opacity: 0.2; } 100% { opacity: 0; } }
@keyframes fxBoltBranchAnim { 0% { opacity: 0; } 6% { opacity: 1; } 20% { opacity: 0.6; } 35% { opacity: 0.85; } 55% { opacity: 0.3; } 100% { opacity: 0; } }
.fx-core-burst { position: absolute; left: -45px; top: -45px; width: 90px; height: 90px; border-radius: 50%; background: radial-gradient(circle, #FFFFFF 0%, #F0DC94 22%, #D5B34C 50%, rgba(213,179,76,0.4) 72%, transparent 100%); animation: fxCoreBurst 1.2s cubic-bezier(.16,.8,.2,1) forwards; }
@keyframes fxCoreBurst { 0% { transform: scale(0.2); opacity: 0; } 8% { transform: scale(2.2); opacity: 1; } 25% { transform: scale(3.5); opacity: 0.85; } 60% { transform: scale(1.6); opacity: 0.4; } 100% { transform: scale(0); opacity: 0; } }
.fx-shockwave { position: absolute; left: -12px; top: -12px; width: 24px; height: 24px; border-radius: 50%; opacity: 0; }
.fx-shockwave.s1 { border: 3px solid #D5B34C; box-shadow: 0 0 24px #D5B34C; animation: fxShock1 1.9s cubic-bezier(.16,.8,.2,1) forwards; }
.fx-shockwave.s2 { border: 2px solid #F0DC94; box-shadow: 0 0 22px #F0DC94; animation: fxShock2 2.1s cubic-bezier(.16,.8,.2,1) 0.08s forwards; }
.fx-shockwave.s3 { border: 2px solid #00D878; box-shadow: 0 0 26px #00D878; animation: fxShock3 2s cubic-bezier(.16,.8,.2,1) 0.15s forwards; }
@keyframes fxShock1 { 0% { transform: scale(0.1) rotateX(65deg); opacity: 0; } 10% { opacity: 1; } 45% { transform: scale(48) rotateX(65deg); opacity: 0.9; } 65% { transform: scale(56) rotateX(65deg); opacity: 0.55; } 100% { transform: scale(12) rotateX(65deg); opacity: 0; } }
@keyframes fxShock2 { 0% { transform: scale(0.1) rotateX(65deg); opacity: 0; } 16% { opacity: 1; } 48% { transform: scale(58) rotateX(65deg); opacity: 0.85; } 68% { transform: scale(66) rotateX(65deg); opacity: 0.45; } 100% { transform: scale(14) rotateX(65deg); opacity: 0; } }
@keyframes fxShock3 { 0% { transform: scale(0.1) rotateX(65deg); opacity: 0; } 14% { opacity: 1; } 42% { transform: scale(70) rotateX(65deg); opacity: 0.7; } 62% { transform: scale(80) rotateX(65deg); opacity: 0.35; } 100% { transform: scale(10) rotateX(65deg); opacity: 0; } }
.fx-holo-ring { position: absolute; left: -22px; top: -22px; width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 50%; opacity: 0; }
.fx-holo-ring.h1 { border: 2px dashed #D5B34C; box-shadow: 0 0 12px #D5B34C; animation: fxHoloExpand 1.5s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1) forwards; }
.fx-holo-ring.h2 { border: 1.5px dotted #00D878; box-shadow: 0 0 12px #00D878; animation: fxHoloExpand 1.7s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1) 0.1s forwards; }
@keyframes fxHoloExpand { 0% { transform: scale(0.1) rotate(0deg); opacity: 0; } 12% { opacity: 1; } 65% { transform: scale(7) rotate(260deg); opacity: 0.7; } 100% { transform: scale(12) rotate(480deg); opacity: 0; } }
.fx-lens-flare { position: absolute; height: 2px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0%, rgba(213,179,76,0.2) 20%, rgba(240,220,148,0.85) 45%, #FFFFFF 50%, rgba(240,220,148,0.85) 55%, rgba(213,179,76,0.2) 80%, transparent 100%); filter: blur(1px); opacity: 0; animation: fxLensFlare 1.5s ease-out forwards; }
@keyframes fxLensFlare { 0% { opacity: 0; transform: scaleX(0.1); } 8% { opacity: 1; transform: scaleX(1); } 30% { opacity: 0.7; transform: scaleX(1.05); } 60% { opacity: 0.3; } 100% { opacity: 0; transform: scaleX(1.1); } }
.fx-collapse-core { position: absolute; width: 40px; height: 40px; margin: -20px 0 0 -20px; border-radius: 50%; background: radial-gradient(circle, #FFFFFF 0%, #D5B34C 50%, transparent 100%); pointer-events: none; opacity: 0; animation: fxCollapseCore 0.4s ease-in forwards; }
@keyframes fxCollapseCore { 0% { transform: scale(2.2); opacity: 1; } 60% { transform: scale(0.6); opacity: 0.8; } 100% { transform: scale(0); opacity: 0; } }
#drac-panel-container.fx-shake { animation: fxPanelShake 0.72s cubic-bezier(.36,.07,.19,.97) both; }
@keyframes fxPanelShake { 0% { transform: translate(0,0) rotate(0deg); } 5% { transform: translate(-6px, 3px) rotate(-0.7deg); } 14% { transform: translate(5px, -4px) rotate(0.6deg); } 26% { transform: translate(-4px, 3px) rotate(-0.4deg); } 42% { transform: translate(3px, -2px) rotate(0.25deg); } 62% { transform: translate(-1.5px, 1px); } 82% { transform: translate(1px, -0.5px); } 100% { transform: translate(0,0) rotate(0deg); } }
.fx-panel-sweep { position: absolute; inset: 0; border-radius: 18px; overflow: hidden; pointer-events: none; z-index: 40; }
.fx-panel-sweep-inner { position: absolute; top: -50%; left: 0; width: 40%; height: 200%; background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0%, rgba(255,255,255,0.15) 30%, rgba(213,179,76,0.75) 50%, rgba(255,255,255,0.15) 70%, transparent 100%); transform: translateX(-150%) skewX(-22deg); animation: fxPanelSweep 1.1s ease-out forwards; }
@keyframes fxPanelSweep { 0% { transform: translateX(-150%) skewX(-22deg); opacity: 0; } 12% { opacity: 1; } 85% { opacity: 1; } 100% { transform: translateX(325%) skewX(-22deg); opacity: 0; } }

/* ═══ PANEL UI ═══ */
@keyframes blink { 0%, 100% { opacity: 1; } 50% { opacity: 0.3; } }
@keyframes rotateCW { 100% { transform: rotate(360deg); } }
@keyframes rotateCCW { 100% { transform: rotate(-360deg); } }
@keyframes metallicSweep { 0% { transform: translateX(-300%) skewX(-25deg); opacity: 0; } 10% { opacity: 1; } 50% { transform: translateX(300%) skewX(-25deg); opacity: 1; } 60%, 100% { transform: translateX(300%) skewX(-25deg); opacity: 0; } }
@keyframes goldPulse { 0%, 100% { text-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(213, 179, 76, 0.4), 0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.9); } 50% { text-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(213, 179, 76, 0.9), 0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.9); } }
@keyframes borderGoldCW { 0% { stroke-dashoffset: 1000; } 100% { stroke-dashoffset: 0; } }
@keyframes borderGreenCCW { 0% { stroke-dashoffset: 0; } 100% { stroke-dashoffset: 1000; } }
@keyframes panelOpenAnim { 0% { opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.3) translateY(50px); } 60% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1.02) translateY(-2px); } 100% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1) translateY(0); } }
@keyframes panelCloseAnim { 0% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1) translateY(0); } 100% { opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.3) translateY(50px); } }
@keyframes boltPulse { 0% { transform: scale(0.85); } 100% { transform: scale(1.15); } }
@keyframes pulseGlowGold { 0%, 100% { text-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(213, 179, 76, 0.6); } 50% { text-shadow: 0 0 16px rgba(213, 179, 76, 1), 0 0 4px #fff; } }
@keyframes popIn { 0% { opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.9); } 100% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); } }

#drac-panel-container { position: fixed; left: 0; top: 0; width: 210px; z-index: 9999; display: none; touch-action: none; will-change: transform; transform: translate3d(0,0,0); backface-visibility: hidden; }
#drac-panel-container.panel-opening { display: block; animation: panelOpenAnim 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.9, 0.3, 1) both; transform-origin: center; }
#drac-panel-container.panel-closing { display: block; animation: panelCloseAnim 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.5, 0, 0.75, 0) both; transform-origin: center; pointer-events: none; }
.panel-body { position: relative; z-index: 5; background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(213, 179, 76, 0.06) 0%, transparent 40%), radial-gradient(circle at 50% 0%, #0A3D2B 0%, #06291E 70%, #041A13 100%); border: 1.5px solid rgba(213, 179, 76, 0.5); border-radius: 18px; padding: 10px; box-shadow: var(--premium-shadow), 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.9), inset 0 2px 8px rgba(213, 179, 76, 0.15), inset 0 -4px 15px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.95); display: flex; flex-direction: column; overflow: hidden; cursor: grab; }
.panel-body:active { cursor: grabbing; }
.panel-body::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 4px; z-index: 1; pointer-events: none; border-radius: 14px; border: 1px solid rgba(213, 179, 76, 0.2); box-shadow: inset 0 0 20px rgba(0, 216, 120, 0.1); }
.panel-body::after { content: ""; position: absolute; top: 0; left: 15%; right: 15%; height: 2px; z-index: 25; pointer-events: none; background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, #F0DC94, transparent); opacity: 0.8; filter: blur(1px); }
.screen-area { cursor: grab; }
.screen-area:active { cursor: grabbing; }
.screen-area .view-state, .btn-container, .drac-btn, .eye-container { cursor: auto; }
.btn-container { cursor: auto; }
.eye-container { cursor: pointer; }
.drac-btn { cursor: pointer; }
.injector-border-svg { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; pointer-events: none; z-index: 30; overflow: visible; }
.border-track-outer { fill: none; stroke: #0A3D2B; stroke-width: 2.5px; vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke; }
.border-track-inner { fill: none; stroke: rgba(213, 179, 76, 0.3); stroke-width: 1px; vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke; }
.laser-line { fill: none; stroke-linecap: round; vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke; will-change: stroke-dashoffset; }
.laser-gold-core { stroke: #fff; stroke-width: 2px; stroke-dasharray: 150 850; animation: borderGoldCW 2.2s linear infinite; }
.laser-green-core { stroke: #fff; stroke-width: 1.8px; stroke-dasharray: 115 385 115 385; animation: borderGreenCCW 2.2s linear infinite; }
.header-top { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; padding: 2px 4px 6px; position: relative; z-index: 10; cursor: grab; }
.header-top:active { cursor: grabbing; }
.header-left { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
.eye-container { width: 26px; height: 26px; position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: radial-gradient(circle at 30% 30%, #1a1305, #041A13 80%); border-radius: 50%; border: 1.5px solid var(--gold-main); box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(213, 179, 76, 0.6), inset 0 0 10px rgba(213, 179, 76, 0.4); }
.eye-container::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: -4px; border-radius: 50%; border: 1px dashed rgba(213, 179, 76, 0.8); animation: rotateCW 4s linear infinite; }
.bolt-icon { width: 12px; height: 12px; fill: var(--gold-main); filter: drop-shadow(0 0 6px #D5B34C); animation: boltPulse 0.8s infinite alternate; }
.header-titles { display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
.brand-title-row { font-family: 'Cinzel', serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: 1px; line-height: 1; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #F0DC94 0%, #D5B34C 50%, #8C6F1E 100%); -webkit-background-clip: text; -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent; animation: goldPulse 3s infinite; }
.brand-sub-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; margin-top: 2px; font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif; font-size: 5.5px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--green-light); letter-spacing: 1px; text-shadow: 0 0 5px rgba(0, 216, 120, 0.5); }
.header-right { text-align: right; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-end; gap: 2px; }
.live-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; font-family: 'Rajdhani', sans-serif; font-size: 7.5px; color: #fff; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 1px; }
.status-dot { width: 4px; height: 4px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--green-main); box-shadow: 0 0 8px var(--green-main); animation: blink 1.5s infinite; }
.status-text { color: var(--gold-light); font-family: 'Exo 2', sans-serif; font-size: 6px; letter-spacing: 0.5px; font-weight: 800; }
.stats-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; font-family: 'Rajdhani', sans-serif; font-size: 8px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--text-muted); background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(0, 216, 120, 0.05) 0%, rgba(0, 216, 120, 0.15) 50%, rgba(0, 216, 120, 0.05) 100%); border-top: 1px solid rgba(0, 216, 120, 0.3); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(213, 179, 76, 0.4); padding: 4px 8px; margin: 0 -5px 6px -5px; letter-spacing: 0.5px; box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.5); }
.stat-item span { color: var(--gold-main); font-weight: 800; text-shadow: 0 0 6px rgba(213, 179, 76, 0.6); }
.screen-area { position: relative; z-index: 10; height: 130px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; text-align: center; background: linear-gradient(rgba(213, 179, 76, 0.04) 1px, transparent 1px), linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(213, 179, 76, 0.04) 1px, transparent 1px), radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%, rgba(0, 216, 120, 0.1) 0%, rgba(6, 41, 30, 0.95) 85%); background-size: 15px 15px, 15px 15px, 100% 100%; border: 1.5px solid rgba(213, 179, 76, 0.3); border-radius: 12px; padding: 8px 6px; box-shadow: inset 0 0 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.95), inset 0 0 15px rgba(0, 216, 120, 0.1), 0 5px 15px rgba(0,0,0,0.8); overflow: hidden; }
.view-state { display: none; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; width: 100%; justify-content: center; z-index: 10; height: 100%; }
.view-state.active { display: flex; animation: popIn 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.9, 0.3, 1) forwards; }
#view-result { justify-content: space-between; padding-top: 2px; padding-bottom: 2px; }
.state-title { font-family: 'Cinzel', serif; font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: 900; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #ffffff 20%, #D5B34C 80%); -webkit-background-clip: text; -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent; filter: drop-shadow(0 2px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.9)); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.5px; margin-bottom: 4px; line-height: 1.2; white-space: nowrap; }
.state-title.single-line { font-size: 11.5px; }
.state-desc { font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif; font-size: 7px; color: var(--green-main); font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 1.2px; margin-bottom: 4px; text-transform: uppercase; text-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(0, 216, 120, 0.6); line-height: 1.2; }
.state-sub { font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif; font-size: 7px; color: var(--text-muted); line-height: 1.2; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.3px; }
.operational-mark { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; width: 100%; margin-bottom: 4px; color: var(--green-main); font-family: 'Exo 2', sans-serif; font-size: 9.5px; font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: 1px; text-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(0, 216, 120, 0.6); }
.operational-mark span { width: 16px; height: 2px; background: var(--green-main); box-shadow: 0 0 8px var(--green-main); }
.operational-mark span:last-child { transform: scaleX(-1); }
.operational-desc { color: var(--gold-main) !important; font-size: 7.5px !important; letter-spacing: 1.2px !important; margin-bottom: 4px !important; }
.uplink-copy strong { color: #fff; font-family: 'Exo 2', sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 8.5px; text-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6); }
.btn-container { display: flex; gap: 6px; position: relative; z-index: 10; margin-top: 8px; }

    var top = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (r.top / wh) - buffer));
    var right = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (r.right / ww) + buffer));
    var bottom = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (r.bottom / wh) + buffer));
    if (!force &&
        Math.abs(left - _lastBounds.l) < 0.005 &&
        Math.abs(top - _lastBounds.t) < 0.005 &&
        Math.abs(right - _lastBounds.r) < 0.005 &&
        Math.abs(bottom - _lastBounds.b) < 0.005 &&
        _lastBounds.open === isOpen) return;
    _lastBounds.l = left; _lastBounds.t = top;
    _lastBounds.r = right; _lastBounds.b = bottom;
    _lastBounds.open = isOpen; _lastBounds.t0 = now;
    if (window.ZAYROUI && window.ZAYROUI.setArea) window.ZAYROUI.setArea(left, top, right, bottom);
    else if (window.ZAYRO && window.ZAYRO.setArea) window.ZAYRO.setArea(left, top, right, bottom);
  } catch(e) {}
}

function getFixedRandomResult(period) {
  var key = String(period);
  if (periodResultCache[key]) return periodResultCache[key];
  var hash = 2166136261;
  for (var i = 0; i < key.length; i++) { hash ^= key.charCodeAt(i); hash = Math.imul(hash, 16777619); }
  var result = String((hash >>> 0) % 10);
  periodResultCache[key] = result;
  return result;
}

function incrementPeriod(periodStr) {
  try {
    var str = String(periodStr).trim();
    if (!/^\d+$/.test(str)) return str;
    var len = str.length;
    var num = BigInt(str) + 1n;
    var next = num.toString();
    while (next.length < len) next = "0" + next;
    return next;
  } catch (e) { var n = parseInt(periodStr, 10); return isNaN(n) ? periodStr : String(n + 1); }
}

function fetchLatestHistory() {
  return fetch(HISTORY_API + '?ts=' + Date.now(), {
    method: "GET",
    headers: { "Accept": "application/json, text/plain, */*" },
    cache: "no-store"
  })
  .then(function(res) { return res.json(); })
  .then(function(data) {
    var list = data && data.data && data.data.list ? data.data.list : [];
    if (!list.length) throw new Error('empty');
    var latest = list[0];
    var completedIssue = String(latest.issueNumber);
    currentPeriod = completedIssue;
    lastPeriod = completedIssue;
    currentResultNum = getFixedRandomResult(completedIssue);

    if (curState === 'scan' || curState === 'result') {
       return { period: completedIssue, result: currentResultNum };
    }

    var seqEl = document.getElementById('statSeq');
    if (seqEl) seqEl.innerText = completedIssue.slice(-5);
    var resTop = document.getElementById('resPeriodTop');
    if (resTop) resTop.innerText = completedIssue.slice(-5);

    return { period: completedIssue, result: currentResultNum };
  });
}

function fetchPeriodWithFallback() {
  return fetchLatestHistory().catch(function() {
    var fake = String(Date.now()).slice(-9);
    currentPeriod = fake;
    lastPeriod = fake;
    currentResultNum = getFixedRandomResult(fake);
    return { period: fake, result: currentResultNum };
  });
}

var _qPercentTimer = null, _qBallTimer = null;
function randomHexSeed() {
  var chars = '0123456789ABCDEF'; var out = '0x';
  for (var i = 0; i < 6; i++) out += chars[Math.floor(Math.random() * 16)];
  return out;
}

function setupQuantumAnimation(targetNum, durationMs) {
  stopQuantumAnimation();
  var seedEl = document.getElementById('qSeedTxt'), pctEl = document.getElementById('qPctTxt'), fillEl = document.getElementById('qProgressFill');
  var statusEl = document.getElementById('qStatusTxt'), orbBall = document.getElementById('qOrbBall'), orbImg = document.getElementById('qOrbImg');
  if (seedEl) seedEl.innerText = 'SEED: ' + randomHexSeed();
  if (pctEl) pctEl.innerText = '1%';
  if (fillEl) fillEl.style.width = '1%';
  if (orbBall) { orbBall.classList.remove('locked'); orbBall.classList.add('spinning'); }
  var curNum = 0;
  var lockAtMs = durationMs - 450;
  var startTime = performance.now();
  numberImages.forEach(function(src) { var img = new Image(); img.src = src; });

  _qBallTimer = setInterval(function() {
    var elapsed = performance.now() - startTime;
    if (elapsed < lockAtMs) {
      curNum = (curNum + 1) % 10;
      if (orbImg) orbImg.src = numberImages[curNum];
      if (seedEl && Math.random() > 0.55) seedEl.innerText = 'SEED: ' + randomHexSeed();
    } else {
      var finalIdx = parseInt(targetNum);
      if (isNaN(finalIdx) || finalIdx < 0 || finalIdx > 9) finalIdx = 0;
      if (orbImg) orbImg.src = numberImages[finalIdx];
      if (orbBall && orbBall.classList.contains('spinning')) {
        orbBall.classList.remove('spinning');
        orbBall.classList.add('locked');
      }
      if (statusEl) statusEl.innerText = 'QUANTUM NODE #' + finalIdx + ' LOCKED';
    }
  }, 120);

  _qPercentTimer = setInterval(function() {
    var elapsed = performance.now() - startTime;
    var pct = Math.min(100, Math.max(1, Math.floor((elapsed / durationMs) * 100)));
    if (pctEl) pctEl.innerText = pct + '%';
    if (fillEl) fillEl.style.width = pct + '%';
    if (elapsed < lockAtMs && statusEl) {
      var nodeNum = (Math.floor(pct / 12) % 9) + 1;
      statusEl.innerText = 'ANALYZING QUANTUM NODE #' + nodeNum + '...';
    }
  }, 40);
}

function stopQuantumAnimation() {
  if (_qPercentTimer) { clearInterval(_qPercentTimer); _qPercentTimer = null; }
  if (_qBallTimer) { clearInterval(_qBallTimer); _qBallTimer = null; }
}

var SCAN_DURATION = 3600;

function runScan() {
  if (S.scanning || isScanning) return;
  S.scanning = true; isScanning = true;

  curState = 'scan';
  S.currentState = 'scan';
  switchView('scan', 'scan', 'WINGO');

  fetchPeriodWithFallback().then(function(data) {
    var predNum = parseInt(data.result, 10);
    if (isNaN(predNum) || predNum < 0 || predNum > 9) predNum = Math.floor(Math.random() * 10);

    var nextPeriod = incrementPeriod(data.period);

    setupQuantumAnimation(predNum, SCAN_DURATION);

    setTimeout(function() {
      stopQuantumAnimation();
      S.scanning = false; isScanning = false;
      finishScan(predNum, nextPeriod);
    }, SCAN_DURATION);

  }).catch(function() {
    var predNum = Math.floor(Math.random() * 10);
    var nextPeriod = incrementPeriod(currentPeriod || String(Date.now()).slice(-9));

    setupQuantumAnimation(predNum, SCAN_DURATION);

    setTimeout(function() {
      stopQuantumAnimation();
      S.scanning = false; isScanning = false;
      finishScan(predNum, nextPeriod);
    }, SCAN_DURATION);
  });
}

function finishScan(predNum, period) {
  var num = parseInt(predNum, 10);
  if (isNaN(num) || num < 0 || num > 9) num = 0;
  var pred = { n: String(num), s: num >= 5 ? 'BIG' : 'SMALL' };

  if (period) {
    lastPeriod = String(period);
    var pStr = lastPeriod.slice(-5);
    if (resPeriodTop) resPeriodTop.innerText = pStr;
    var seqEl = document.getElementById('statSeq');
    if (seqEl) seqEl.innerText = pStr;
  }

  renderResult(pred);
  goState('result');

  playAudioDirect(pred.s === 'BIG' ? 'big.mp3' : 'small.mp3', true);
}

(function(){
  var dragStarted = false;
  var moved = false;
  var startX = 0, startY = 0;
  var originL = 0, originT = 0;
  var raf = null;
  var THRESHOLD = 8;

  function startDrag(x, y){
    var r = miniBtn.getBoundingClientRect();
    originL = r.left; originT = r.top;
    miniBtn.style.right = "auto"; miniBtn.style.bottom = "auto";
    miniBtn.style.left = originL + "px"; miniBtn.style.top = originT + "px";
    miniBtn.style.transform = '';
    startX = x; startY = y;
    dragStarted = true; moved = false;
  }

  function moveDrag(x, y){
    if(!dragStarted) return;
    var dx = x - startX, dy = y - startY;
    if(!moved && (Math.abs(dx) > THRESHOLD || Math.abs(dy) > THRESHOLD)){
      moved = true; isCurrentlyDragging = true; setJavaDrag(true);
    }
    if(!moved) return;
    if(raf) cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
    raf = requestAnimationFrame(function(){
      var maxX = window.innerWidth  - miniBtn.offsetWidth  - 6;
      var maxY = window.innerHeight - miniBtn.offsetHeight - 6;
      var nx = originL + dx, ny = originT + dy;
      if(nx < 6) nx = 6; if(ny < 6) ny = 6;
      if(nx > maxX) nx = maxX; if(ny > maxY) ny = maxY;
      miniBtn.style.left = nx + "px"; miniBtn.style.top = ny + "px";
    });
  }

  function stopDrag(){
    if(!dragStarted) return;
    dragStarted = false;
    if(raf){ cancelAnimationFrame(raf); raf = null; }
    isCurrentlyDragging = false;
    setJavaDrag(false);
    syncBoundsToJava(true);
  }

  miniBtn.addEventListener("touchstart", function(e){
    if(e.touches.length !== 1) return;
    if(e.cancelable) e.preventDefault();
    var t = e.touches[0]; if(t) startDrag(t.clientX, t.clientY);
  }, {passive:false});

  miniBtn.addEventListener("touchmove", function(e){
    if(!dragStarted) return;
    var t = e.touches[0]; if(t) moveDrag(t.clientX, t.clientY);
    if(moved && e.cancelable) e.preventDefault();
  }, {passive:false});

  miniBtn.addEventListener("touchend", function(e){
    var wasTap = !moved; stopDrag();
    if(wasTap){ openPanelAnimated(); }
  }, {passive:true});

  miniBtn.addEventListener("touchcancel", function(){ stopDrag(); }, {passive:true});

(function() {
  var drag = false, sx = 0, sy = 0, sl = 0, st = 0, pw = 0, ph = 0;
  var rafPending = false, dx = 0, dy = 0;
  var maxX = 0, maxY = 0;

  function isBtn(target) {
    while (target && target !== panel) {
      if (target.id === 'fxOrigin') return true;
      var tag = (target.tagName || '').toLowerCase();
      if (tag === 'button' || tag === 'a' || tag === 'input') return true;
      target = target.parentNode;
    }
    return false;
  }

  function start(x, y) {
    drag = true; sx = x; sy = y;
    var r = panel.getBoundingClientRect();
    sl = r.left; st = r.top; pw = r.width; ph = r.height;
    panel.style.transform = '';
    panel.style.willChange = 'transform';
    maxX = window.innerWidth  - pw;
    maxY = window.innerHeight - ph;
    dx = 0; dy = 0;
  }

  function tick() {
    rafPending = false;
    if (!drag) return;
    var nl = Math.max(0, Math.min(maxX, sl + dx));
    var nt = Math.max(0, Math.min(maxY, st + dy));
    panel.style.transform = 'translate3d(' + (nl - sl) + 'px,' + (nt - st) + 'px,0)';
  }

  function move(x, y) {
    if (!drag) return;
    dx = x - sx; dy = y - sy;
    if (!rafPending) { rafPending = true; requestAnimationFrame(tick); }
  }

  function end() {
    if (!drag) return;
    drag = false;
    if (rafPending) { cancelAnimationFrame(rafPending); rafPending = false; }
    var finalL = Math.max(0, Math.min(maxX, sl + dx));
    var finalT = Math.max(0, Math.min(maxY, st + dy));
    panel.style.transform = '';
    panel.style.left = finalL + 'px';
    panel.style.top  = finalT + 'px';
    panel.style.willChange = '';
    syncBoundsToJava(true);
  }

  if (window.PointerEvent) {
    panel.addEventListener('pointerdown', function(e){
      if (isBtn(e.target)) return;
      if (e.pointerType === 'mouse' && e.button !== 0) return;
      try { panel.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId); } catch(err){}
      start(e.clientX, e.clientY);
    });
    panel.addEventListener('pointermove', function(e){
      if (drag) move(e.clientX, e.clientY);
    });
    panel.addEventListener('pointerup', end);
    panel.addEventListener('pointercancel', end);
  } else {
    panel.addEventListener('mousedown', function(e){
      if (isBtn(e.target)) return;
      start(e.clientX, e.clientY);
      e.preventDefault();
    });
    panel.addEventListener('touchstart', function(e){
      if (isBtn(e.target)) return;
      start(e.touches[0].clientX, e.touches[0].clientY);
    }, { passive: true });
    document.addEventListener('mousemove', function(e){ if (drag) move(e.clientX, e.clientY); });
    document.addEventListener('touchmove', function(e){
      if (drag) { move(e.touches[0].clientX, e.touches[0].clientY); e.preventDefault(); }
    }, { passive: false });
    document.addEventListener('mouseup', end);
    document.addEventListener('touchend', end);
    document.addEventListener('touchcancel', end);
  }
})();

/* ═══ LIGHTNING FX ENGINE ═══ */
var isFxPlaying = false;
var _fx = {
  playing: false, timers: [], rafId: null, particles: [], sprites: null,
  canvas: null, ctx: null, vw: 0, vh: 0, dpr: 1, lastTime: 0,
  sweepEl: null, hidden: false
};

function _fxHasReduced() { return _REDUCED_MOTION; }

function _fxBuildSprites() {
  if (_fx.sprites) return _fx.sprites;
  var colors = { gold: ['#FFFFFF', '#D5B34C'], green: ['#B9F6CA', '#00D878'], white: ['#FFFFFF', '#F0DC94'] };
  var size = 32; var out = {};
  for (var key in colors) {
    if (!colors.hasOwnProperty(key)) continue;
    var c = document.createElement('canvas');
    c.width = c.height = size;
    var g = c.getContext('2d');
    var grad = g.createRadialGradient(size/2, size/2, 0, size/2, size/2, size/2);
    grad.addColorStop(0, colors[key][0]);
    grad.addColorStop(0.35, colors[key][1]);
    grad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
    g.fillStyle = grad; g.beginPath(); g.arc(size/2, size/2, size/2, 0, Math.PI * 2); g.fill();
    out[key] = c;
  }
  _fx.sprites = out; return out;
}

function _fxBoltPath(sx, sy, ex, ey, segs, jitter) {
  var d = 'M' + sx.toFixed(1) + ',' + sy.toFixed(1);
  var dx = (ex - sx) / segs; var dy = (ey - sy) / segs;
  for (var i = 1; i < segs; i++) {
    var x = sx + dx * i + (Math.random() - 0.5) * jitter;
    var y = sy + dy * i + (Math.random() - 0.5) * jitter;
    d += 'L' + x.toFixed(1) + ',' + y.toFixed(1);
  }
  d += 'L' + ex.toFixed(1) + ',' + ey.toFixed(1);
  return d;
}

function _fxBuildLightningSVG(layer, ox, oy, vw, vh, maxR, wave) {
  var svgNS = 'http://www.w3.org/2000/svg';
  var svg = document.createElementNS(svgNS, 'svg');
  svg.setAttribute('class', 'fx-bolts-svg');
  svg.setAttribute('width', vw); svg.setAttribute('height', vh);
  svg.setAttribute('viewBox', '0 0 ' + vw + ' ' + vh);
  svg.setAttribute('preserveAspectRatio', 'none');
  var boltCount = _IS_LOW_END ? 3 : 4;
  var lenMul = wave === 'main' ? 0.95 : 0.5;
  var jitter = wave === 'main' ? 30 : 16;
  var segs = wave === 'main' ? 8 : 5;
  for (var b = 0; b < boltCount; b++) {
    var angle = (b / boltCount) * Math.PI * 2 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.5;
    var len = maxR * lenMul * (0.55 + Math.random() * 0.4);
    var ex = ox + Math.cos(angle) * len;
    var ey = oy + Math.sin(angle) * len;
    var d = _fxBoltPath(ox, oy, ex, ey, segs, jitter);
    var del = b * 0.015;
    var main = document.createElementNS(svgNS, 'path');
    main.setAttribute('d', d); main.setAttribute('class', 'fx-bolt-main');
    main.style.animationDelay = del + 's'; svg.appendChild(main);
    if (wave === 'main' && !_IS_LOW_END) {
      var core = document.createElementNS(svgNS, 'path');
      core.setAttribute('d', d); core.setAttribute('class', 'fx-bolt-core');
      core.style.animationDelay = del + 's'; svg.appendChild(core);
    }
    var branches = 1;
    for (var j = 0; j < branches; j++) {
      var bp = 0.3 + Math.random() * 0.5;
      var bx = ox + Math.cos(angle) * len * bp;
      var by = oy + Math.sin(angle) * len * bp;
      var sa = angle + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 1.4;
      var sl = len * (0.15 + Math.random() * 0.25);
      var sd = _fxBoltPath(bx, by, bx + Math.cos(sa) * sl, by + Math.sin(sa) * sl, 4, 14);
      var br = document.createElementNS(svgNS, 'path');
      br.setAttribute('d', sd); br.setAttribute('class', 'fx-bolt-branch');
      br.style.animationDelay = (del + 0.04) + 's';
      svg.appendChild(br);
    }
  }
  layer.appendChild(svg);
}

function _fxBuildParticles(ox, oy, vw, vh) {
  var dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, _IS_LOW_END ? 1.0 : 1.25);
  var canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
  canvas.style.cssText = 'position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;pointer-events:none;';
  canvas.width = vw * dpr; canvas.height = vh * dpr;
  var ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
  _fx.canvas = canvas; _fx.ctx = ctx; _fx.vw = vw; _fx.vh = vh; _fx.dpr = dpr;
  _fx.particles.length = 0; _fx.lastTime = 0;
  var layer = document.getElementById('nova-fx-layer');
  if (layer) layer.appendChild(canvas);
  var sprites = _fxBuildSprites();
  var spriteKeys = ['gold', 'green', 'white'];
  var count = _IS_LOW_END ? 16 : 28;
  for (var i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    var angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
    var speed = 130 + Math.random() * 380;
    var key = spriteKeys[i % 3];
    _fx.particles.push({
      x: ox, y: oy,
      vx: Math.cos(angle) * speed, vy: Math.sin(angle) * speed,
      scale: 0.55 + Math.random() * 0.55,
      life: 0, maxLife: 0.85 + Math.random() * 0.85,
      sprite: sprites[key],
      rot: Math.random() * Math.PI, rotSpeed: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 10
    });
  }
  _fx.rafId = requestAnimationFrame(_fxTick);
}

function _fxTick(now) {
  if (!_fx.canvas || !_fx.ctx) return;
  if (_fx.hidden) { _fx.rafId = null; return; }
  if (!_fx.lastTime) _fx.lastTime = now;
  var dt = (now - _fx.lastTime) / 1000; _fx.lastTime = now;
  if (dt > 0.05) dt = 0.05;
  var ctx = _fx.ctx;
  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, _fx.vw, _fx.vh);
  var arr = _fx.particles;
  for (var i = arr.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    var p = arr[i];
    p.life += dt;
    if (p.life >= p.maxLife) { arr.splice(i, 1); continue; }
    p.vx *= 0.965; p.vy *= 0.965; p.vy += 34 * dt;
    p.x += p.vx * dt; p.y += p.vy * dt; p.rot += p.rotSpeed * dt;
    var t = p.life / p.maxLife; var alpha = 1 - t;
    var sz = p.sprite.width * p.scale * (1 - t * 0.4);
    ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;
    ctx.drawImage(p.sprite, p.x - sz/2, p.y - sz/2, sz, sz);
  }
  if (arr.length > 0) { _fx.rafId = requestAnimationFrame(_fxTick); }
  else { _fx.rafId = null; ctx.clearRect(0, 0, _fx.vw, _fx.vh); }
}

function _fxAddPanelSweep(panelEl) {
  if (!panelEl) return;
  var body = panelEl.querySelector('.panel-body'); if (!body) return;
  var sweep = document.createElement('div');
  sweep.className = 'fx-panel-sweep';
  var inner = document.createElement('div');
  inner.className = 'fx-panel-sweep-inner';
  sweep.appendChild(inner); body.appendChild(sweep);
  _fx.sweepEl = sweep;
  _fxSchedule(function() {
    if (sweep.parentNode) sweep.parentNode.removeChild(sweep);
    if (_fx.sweepEl === sweep) _fx.sweepEl = null;
  }, 1400);
}

function _fxSchedule(fn, ms) {
  var id = setTimeout(fn, ms);
  _fx.timers.push(id);
  return id;
}

function _fxCleanup() {
  for (var i = 0; i < _fx.timers.length; i++) clearTimeout(_fx.timers[i]);
  _fx.timers.length = 0;
  if (_fx.rafId) { cancelAnimationFrame(_fx.rafId); _fx.rafId = null; }
  _fx.particles.length = 0; _fx.lastTime = 0;
  _fx.canvas = null; _fx.ctx = null;
  if (_fx.sweepEl && _fx.sweepEl.parentNode) _fx.sweepEl.parentNode.removeChild(_fx.sweepEl);
  _fx.sweepEl = null;
  var layer = document.getElementById('nova-fx-layer');
  if (layer) {
    layer.style.transform = ''; layer.style.opacity = '';
    layer.style.transition = ''; layer.style.transformOrigin = '';
    layer.classList.remove('active'); layer.innerHTML = '';
  }
  var panelEl = document.getElementById('drac-panel-container');
  if (panelEl) panelEl.classList.remove('fx-shake');
  isFxPlaying = false; _fx.playing = false;
}

function triggerLightningFX() {
  if (isFxPlaying || _fx.playing) return;
  if (_fxHasReduced()) return;
  var originEl = document.getElementById('fxOrigin');
  var panelEl = document.getElementById('drac-panel-container');
  var layer = document.getElementById('nova-fx-layer');
  if (!originEl || !layer) return;
  isFxPlaying = true; _fx.playing = true;
  var rect = originEl.getBoundingClientRect();
  var ox = rect.left + rect.width / 2;
  var oy = rect.top + rect.height / 2;
  var vw = window.innerWidth, vh = window.innerHeight;
  var maxR = Math.sqrt(vw * vw + vh * vh);
  layer.innerHTML = ''; layer.style.transform = ''; layer.style.opacity = '';
  layer.style.transition = ''; layer.style.transformOrigin = '';
  layer.classList.add('active');

  var chargeWrap = document.createElement('div');
  chargeWrap.className = 'fx-origin';
  chargeWrap.style.left = ox + 'px'; chargeWrap.style.top = oy + 'px';
  layer.appendChild(chargeWrap);
  var ccore = document.createElement('div');
  ccore.className = 'fx-charge-core';
  chargeWrap.appendChild(ccore);
  for (var c = 1; c <= 3; c++) {
    var cr = document.createElement('div');
    cr.className = 'fx-charge-ring r' + c;
    cr.style.animationDelay = ((c - 1) * 0.05) + 's';
    chargeWrap.appendChild(cr);
  }

  _fxSchedule(function() {
    if (!_fx.playing) return;
    var flash = document.createElement('div');
    flash.className = 'fx-screen-flash';
    flash.style.setProperty('--fx-x', ox + 'px');
    flash.style.setProperty('--fx-y', oy + 'px');
    layer.appendChild(flash);
    _fxBuildLightningSVG(layer, ox, oy, vw, vh, maxR, 'main');
    var burstWrap = document.createElement('div');
    burstWrap.className = 'fx-origin';
    burstWrap.style.left = ox + 'px'; burstWrap.style.top = oy + 'px';
    layer.appendChild(burstWrap);
    var coreBurst = document.createElement('div');
    coreBurst.className = 'fx-core-burst';
    burstWrap.appendChild(coreBurst);
    for (var s = 1; s <= 3; s++) {
      var sw = document.createElement('div');
      sw.className = 'fx-shockwave s' + s;
      burstWrap.appendChild(sw);
    }
    var hr = document.createElement('div');
    hr.className = 'fx-holo-ring h1';
    burstWrap.appendChild(hr);
    var lf = document.createElement('div');
    lf.className = 'fx-lens-flare';
    lf.style.left = (ox - vw) + 'px';
    lf.style.top = (oy - 1) + 'px';
    lf.style.width = (vw * 2) + 'px';
    layer.appendChild(lf);
    _fxBuildParticles(ox, oy, vw, vh);
    if (panelEl) {
      panelEl.classList.remove('fx-shake');
      void panelEl.offsetWidth;
      panelEl.classList.add('fx-shake');
    }
    _fxAddPanelSweep(panelEl);
  }, 220);

  _fxSchedule(function() {
    if (!_fx.playing) return;
    layer.style.transition = 'transform 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.6, 0, 0.4, 1), opacity 0.45s ease-in';
    layer.style.transformOrigin = ox + 'px ' + oy + 'px';
    layer.style.transform = 'scale(0.02)';
    layer.style.opacity = '0';
    var miniFlash = document.createElement('div');
    miniFlash.className = 'fx-collapse-core';
    miniFlash.style.left = ox + 'px'; miniFlash.style.top = oy + 'px';
    layer.appendChild(miniFlash);
    var arr = _fx.particles;
    for (var i = 0; i < arr.length; i++) {
      var p = arr[i];
      var dx = ox - p.x, dy = oy - p.y;
      var dist = Math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy) || 1;
      p.vx = (dx / dist) * 500;
      p.vy = (dy / dist) * 500;
      p.maxLife = Math.max(p.life + 0.45, p.maxLife);
    }
  }, 2600);

  _fxSchedule(_fxCleanup, 3100);
}

function _fxOnVisibility() {
  _fx.hidden = document.hidden;
  if (!document.hidden && _fx.canvas && !_fx.rafId && _fx.particles.length > 0) {
    _fx.lastTime = 0;

  }
}

    timer = setTimeout(createCard, 7000 + Math.random() * 900);
  }
  timer = setTimeout(createCard, 3000);
  window.goldTicker = {
    stop: function() { clearTimeout(timer); clearTimeout(removeTimer); timer = null; removeTimer = null; removeCard(); },
    start: function() { clearTimeout(timer); timer = setTimeout(createCard, 100); }
  };
})();

document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', function() {
  if (document.hidden) {
    var sl = document.getElementById('snowLayer'); if (sl) sl.classList.add('paused');
    if (_pingTimer) { clearTimeout(_pingTimer); _pingTimer = null; }
    if (_periodTimer) { clearInterval(_periodTimer); _periodTimer = null; }
    if (window.goldTicker && window.goldTicker.stop) window.goldTicker.stop();
  } else {
    var sl = document.getElementById('snowLayer'); if (sl) sl.classList.remove('paused');
    if (_pingTimer === null) _pingTimer = setTimeout(function pingLoop(){
      var pv = document.getElementById('statPing');
      if (pv) {
        var ms = Math.floor(Math.random() * 30) + 15;
        pv.textContent = ms + 'MS';
        pv.style.color = ms > 35 ? '#FFB800' : '#00D878';
      }
      _pingTimer = setTimeout(pingLoop, 3000);
    }, 3000);
    if (_periodTimer === null) startPeriodLoop();
    if (window.goldTicker && window.goldTicker.start) window.goldTicker.start();
  }
});
